title: Status Effect
description: Defines a single, modular status effect or condition with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the status effect.

status_type.description: Whether the status is beneficial, detrimental, or neutral for UI and logic purposes.

category.description: The category of status effect for organization and filtering.

severity.description: The severity level of the status effect.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of what the status effect represents and how it feels to experience it. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this status effect, often from Star Wars lore.

description.description: Detailed mechanical description of what the status effect does.

duration.description: How long the status effect lasts, e.g., '1 minute', 'Concentration', 'Until removed'.

stacking.description: Rules for how this status effect stacks with itself or similar effects.

self_stackable.description: Whether multiple instances of this status can stack on the same target.

max_stacks.description: Maximum number of stacks allowed (if self_stackable is true).

stacking_behavior.description: How multiple stacks interact with each other.

effects.description: The mechanical rules this status applies to a target, using our master effects schema.

effect.description: The type of effect this status provides.

parameters.description: Parameters for the effect, varies by effect type.

conditions.description: Conditions that must be met for this effect to apply.

scaling_per_stack.description: Optional dynamic scaling based on the number of stacks of this status effect.

property_to_scale.description: The property within parameters that scales with stacks (e.g., 'damage_dice', 'duration', 'range').

modification.description: How the property scales with each additional stack.

value.description: The scaling value (e.g., +1 damage, +1d4 dice, +1 round duration).

max_scaling.description: Optional maximum scaling limit to prevent infinite growth.

removal_conditions.description: Conditions that can remove this status effect.

description.description: Human-readable description of the removal condition.

parameters.description: Additional parameters for the removal condition.

class_synergies.description: Classes that have special interactions with this status effect.

species_synergies.description: Species that have special interactions with this status effect.

faction_synergies.description: Factions that have special interactions with this status effect.

iconic_usage.description: Example of how this status effect is typically used in Star Wars lore.

tactical_notes.description: Tactical advice for when and how this status effect is most effective.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this status effect.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying characters affected by this status.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this status effect, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this status effect adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Character_Portrait', 'Combat_Scene', 'Location').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this status effect is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the status effect's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the status effect's icon for UI display.

color.description: Primary color for UI elements (hex code or color name).
